subject: Air freight quote to EZE
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to EZE (Buenos Aires, AR), including collection at our site in 28261 (Bremen), Germany? Please arrange the truck from our site to the airport.

The laboratory glassware will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26. The shipment consists of 3 pieces, with a gross weight of 676 kg and a total volume of 3.44 cbm.

Please send me your all-in price in EUR and let me know when the shipment would arrive at EZE.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
